tests.title: Profile struct exports all required fields with correct types
given: the internal/lang package is compiled
tests.when: a Profile value is constructed with all fields populated
then: Name is a string, Manifests is a []string, Test/Lint/Format/Build/Targeted/Version are each Command, Programs is a []string, TestFile is a func(string) bool, InlineTests is a bool, TestID is a *regexp.Regexp, Stub is a string, SkipMarkers and AssertPattern are *regexp.Regexp, GateConfig is a func(string) bool, ReadRoots is a func(string) []ReadRoot, Caches is a []string
tests.pseudocode: var p lang.Profile; p.Name = "go"; p.Manifests = []string{"go.mod"}; p.Test = lang.Command{}; p.TestFile = func(s string) bool { return false }; p.ReadRoots = func(s string) []lang.ReadRoot { return nil }; // compiles without error

tests.title: Command struct holds Base argv and Resolve returns variant when lockfile present
given: a Command with Base ["pytest", "-q"] and a lockfile variant for "uv.lock" producing ["uv", "run", "pytest", "-q"]
a temp directory containing uv.lock
then: the returned []string equals ["uv", "run", "pytest", "-q"]
tests.pseudocode: cmd := lang.Command{Base: []string{"pytest","-q"}, Variant: lang.Variant{File: "uv.lock", Argv: []string{"uv","run","pytest","-q"}}}; os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "uv.lock"), nil, 0644); assert.Equal(cmd.Resolve(root), []string{"uv","run","pytest","-q"})

tests.title: Command.Resolve returns base argv when lockfile is absent
given: a Command with Base ["pytest", "-q"] and a lockfile variant for "uv.lock"
a temp directory with no uv.lock
then: the returned []string equals ["pytest", "-q"]
tests.pseudocode: cmd := lang.Command{Base: []string{"pytest","-q"}, Variant: lang.Variant{File: "uv.lock", Argv: []string{"uv","run","pytest","-q"}}}; got := cmd.Resolve(root); assert.Equal(got, []string{"pytest","-q"})

tests.title: Every ecosystem handled by the old DetectProfile has a profile row in the table
given: the profile table in internal/lang
tests.when: for any ecosystem name in [go, rust, python, node, jvm, dotnet, ruby, elixir, php, dart, swift, cpp, generic], the table is queried
then: a profile with that Name exists in the table
the generic profile has empty commands and no programs
tests.pseudocode: for _, name := range []string{"go","rust","python","node","jvm","dotnet","ruby","elixir","php","dart","swift","cpp","generic"} { p := lang.ProfileByName(name); assert.NotNil(p); assert.Equal(p.Name, name) }; g := lang.ProfileByName("generic"); assert.Empty(g.Programs); assert.Empty(g.Test.Base)

tests.title: Each profile's Programs match the toolchain binaries from the old BuildPrograms for that ecosystem
given: the go profile in the table
then: it contains go, gofmt, and golangci-lint
tests.pseudocode: p := lang.ProfileByName("go"); assert.Contains(p.Programs, "go"); assert.Contains(p.Programs, "gofmt")

tests.title: Each profile's Stub matches the StubMarker from the old DetectProfile
given: the profile table
tests.when: the Stub field of the go and python profiles are read
then: go Stub equals panic("not implemented")
python Stub equals raise NotImplementedError
tests.pseudocode: p := lang.ProfileByName("go"); assert.Equal(p.Stub, `panic("not implemented")`); py := lang.ProfileByName("python"); assert.Equal(py.Stub, "raise NotImplementedError")

tests.title: Detect returns a Detection with Primary and All in precedence order for a multi-manifest repo
given: a temp directory containing go.mod and package.json
then: Detection.Primary.Name equals go
Detection.All has length 2
Detection.All[0].Name equals go and Detection.All[1].Name equals node
tests.pseudocode: os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "go.mod"), []byte("module x"), 0644); os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "package.json"), []byte("{}"), 0644); d := lang.Detect(root); assert.Equal(d.Primary.Name, "go"); assert.Equal(len(d.All), 2); assert.Equal(d.All[1].Name, "node")

tests.title: Detect returns generic profile when no manifest matches
given: an empty temp directory
then: Detection.Primary.Name equals generic
Detection.All contains only the generic profile
tests.pseudocode: d := lang.Detect(root); assert.Equal(d.Primary.Name, "generic"); assert.Equal(len(d.All), 1); assert.Equal(d.All[0].Name, "generic")

tests.title: Detection.Programs returns the deduplicated union of all detected profiles' programs
given: a temp directory containing go.mod and package.json
then: the result contains go toolchain binaries and node toolchain binaries
no program appears twice
tests.pseudocode: d := lang.Detect(root); progs := d.Programs(); assert.Contains(progs, "go"); assert.Contains(progs, "node"); seen := map[string]int{}; for _, p := range progs { seen[p]++ }; for _, c := range seen { assert.Equal(c, 1) }

tests.title: Detection.TestFile returns true for any detected profile's test convention and common directories
given: a Detection with go and node profiles
tests.when: TestFile is called with foo_test.go, foo.test.ts, and testdata/x.go
then: all three return true
tests.pseudocode: d := lang.Detect(root); assert.True(d.TestFile("foo_test.go")); assert.True(d.TestFile("foo.test.ts")); assert.True(d.TestFile("testdata/x.go"))

tests.title: Detection.IsSourceFile returns true for extensions recognised by any detected profile
given: a Detection with go and node profiles
tests.when: IsSourceFile is called with main.go, app.ts, and readme.md
then: main.go returns true
app.ts returns true
readme.md returns false

tests.title: Detect returns generic profile when root directory cannot be read
given: a path to a non-existent directory
tests.when: lang.Detect is called with a non-existent path
then: Detection.Primary.Name equals generic
no panic or error occurs
tests.pseudocode: d := lang.Detect("/nonexistent/path/that/does/not/exist"); assert.Equal(d.Primary.Name, "generic")

tests.title: VerifyCommand returns Makefile targets when present
given: a temp directory with go.mod and a Makefile containing test: and lint: targets
then: the test command is make test
the lint command is make lint
tests.pseudocode:
os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "Makefile"), []byte("test:
	go test
lint:
	go vet
"), 0644); d := lang.Detect(root); test, lint := d.VerifyCommand(root); assert.Equal(test, "make test"); assert.Equal(lint, "make lint")

tests.title: VerifyCommand falls back to primary profile commands when no Makefile exists
given: a temp directory with go.mod and no Makefile
then: the test command is the go profile's Test command resolved
the lint command is the go profile's Lint command resolved
tests.pseudocode: d := lang.Detect(root); test, lint := d.VerifyCommand(root); assert.Equal(test, "go test ./... -count=1"); assert.Equal(lint, "go vet ./...")

tests.title: VerifyCommand returns make check when Makefile has check target but no test target
given: a temp directory with go.mod and a Makefile containing check: but no test: target
then: the test command is make check
tests.pseudocode: os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "Makefile"), []byte("check:\n\tgo test\n"), 0644); d := lang.Detect(root); test, _ := d.VerifyCommand(root); assert.Equal(test, "make check")

tests.title: VerifyCommand returns empty strings when no Makefile and generic profile
given: an empty temp directory with no manifests and no Makefile
then: the test command is empty
the lint command is empty
tests.pseudocode: d := lang.Detect(root); test, lint := d.VerifyCommand(root); assert.Equal(test, ""); assert.Equal(lint, "")

tests.title: checks.Detect delegates to lang.Detect and returns the test command
given: a temp directory with go.mod and a Makefile containing test: target
then: the returned string equals make test
the function signature is unchanged (returns a single string)
tests.pseudocode: os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "go.mod"), []byte("module x"), 0644); os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "Makefile"), []byte("test:\n\tgo test\n"), 0644); got := checks.Detect(root); assert.Equal(got, "make test")

tests.title: ReadRoot struct has Module, Path, Abs, and Source fields matching old project.ReadRoot
given: the internal/lang package is compiled
then: Module, Path, Abs, and Source fields are accessible as strings
tests.pseudocode: r := lang.ReadRoot{Module: "example.com/lib", Path: "../lib", Abs: "/abs/lib", Source: "go.mod"}; assert.Equal(r.Module, "example.com/lib")

tests.title: Detection.ReadRoots returns the union of all detected profiles' read roots, deduplicated by abs path
given: a temp directory with go.mod containing a local replace directive pointing to an existing sibling directory
then: the returned slice contains the read root from the go.mod replace directive
no two entries have the same Abs value
tests.pseudocode: d := lang.Detect(root); roots := d.ReadRoots(root); assert.True(len(roots) > 0); abs := map[string]bool{}; for _, r := range roots { assert.False(abs[r.Abs]); abs[r.Abs] = true }

tests.title: ReadRoots returns empty slice when manifest cannot be parsed
given: a temp directory with a go.mod containing invalid syntax
tests.when: the go profile's ReadRoots function is called on that root
then: the returned slice is empty
no error is returned
tests.pseudocode: os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "go.mod"), []byte("not valid go.mod content %%%"), 0644); d := lang.Detect(root); roots := d.ReadRoots(root); assert.Empty(roots)

tests.title: Each profile's TestFile encodes the correct language-specific conventions
given: the profile table
tests.when: each profile's TestFile is called with its language's test file patterns and non-test files
then: Go: foo_test.go returns true, foo.go returns false
Python: test_foo.py and foo_test.py return true, foo.py returns false
Node: foo.test.ts and foo.spec.js return true, foo.ts returns false
Rust: foo_test.rs returns true
JVM: FooTest.java and FooIT.java return true
Ruby: foo_spec.rb returns true
tests.pseudocode: goP := lang.ProfileByName("go"); assert.True(goP.TestFile("foo_test.go")); assert.False(goP.TestFile("foo.go")); pyP := lang.ProfileByName("python"); assert.True(pyP.TestFile("test_foo.py")); assert.True(pyP.TestFile("foo_test.py"))
